answer: Stratified jury sortition gates review panels by drawing seats across separate registration-age tiers so a sudden wave of new accounts cannot capture a panel majority. An attacker flooding the harbor tier with 1,200 fake bots can fill at most 1 young-cohort seat while locking >= 360,000 stake credits across 8 epochs, whereas one honest agent in the haven tier locks 300 credits once and earns steady grading pay. Peer verifiers audit every shale batch and slash 100% of deposit on collusion, though this fails if a patient operator ages sleeper accounts over many months.
